# ANALYSIS: BASE_ENGINE_STAGE_1_BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are executing a Stage-1 backtest on the base engine (no strategy changes) to generate the required OP-16 anchor-day performance metrics, out-of-sample (OOS) performance, and real-fills simulation results. This establishes the baseline against which all strategy candidates are measured per OP-16.

## Mechanism

The base engine runs as-defined in the current production parameters (`automation/state/params.json`) and logic. The Stage-1 backtest harness (autoresearch grinder) processes the full historical dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using the engine's entry/exit rules, position sizing, and risk controls. No modifications are applied; we collect raw performance data for the anchor days, OOS windows, and real-fills simulation.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Base engine assumes $25K+ account for full qty execution (per OP-20 disclosure 1). $1K paper account scales to ~14% of headline P&L (e.g., $1,083 headline → ~$152 realized).
2. **Sample bias:** Uses 16.5 months of historical data (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) with standard leaderboard cuts. Overfit risk mitigated by OP-16 anchor day holdout and planned OOS validation. Sample size: ~345 trading days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (Stage-1 is in-sample; OOS requires Stage-2 walk-forward held-out window)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (Stage-1 uses BS-sim or similar; real-fills simulation requires Stage-1 run with cached real OPRA fills and slippage model)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: unknown; max drawdown: unknown; blow-up scenario: catastrophic loss on single day exceeding 50% daily risk cap (e.g., adverse gap through chart stop).
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (top-5 days % of P&L TBD)

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators (all tests must pass), walk-forward OOS positive (test_per_mo / train_per_mo ≥ 0.7), real-fills validation on top 3 J days (simulated P&L diff < ±20% from BS-sim), and OP-16 anchor edge_capture ≥ 771 (50% of max 1542).

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- Confidence will be calibrated post-backtest based on OP-16 anchor day results and OOS metrics.
